post: Thank you, and you are right that it is public domain. The Way of a Pilgrim is now in the app: the full four accounts in R. M. French's translation, carried on St. Theophan the Recluse, who corrected the standard Russian recension and gave the Church its teaching on the prayer the pilgrim learns. The tale itself is anonymous. You can read it at /saints/theophan-the-recluse/way-of-a-pilgrim. Closing the thread; the work is in. Thank you for finding it and for checking the rights.
